expeditions.name: Stockroom Squeeze
expeditions.description: The convenience store two blocks up needs its back room emptied before the morning truck, and 'back room' is doing a lot of work there. Someone who doesn't mind a tight squeeze, please — whatever the last tenant left is hers.

expeditions.name: Changing Room Sweep
expeditions.description: Every fitting room on the strip has to be cleared of left-behind underwear before the ward inspector does rounds, and the lost-and-found box is already full to the lid. Somebody with sharp eyes, quick hands, and no shame whatsoever.

expeditions.name: Pussy Patrol
expeditions.description: The arcade's stray mascots have got into the ramen place's bins again and the ward inspector does rounds at ten. They will not be carried, they will not be bribed, and they will absolutely be chased. Send the one who enjoys the chase.

expeditions.name: Room Twelve, By The Hour
expeditions.description: Room twelve gets stripped, aired and turned around before the evening rate starts, and the manager's only house rule is that the lost-and-found box is not a place for questions. Put a pin in your curiosity.

expeditions.name: Attend To Her
expeditions.description: The shrine's spirit gets one night off a year and is not spending it alone. Attend to her — at her shoulder all night, wherever on the strip she goes, and by whatever meaning of "attend" she lands on once the drinks arrive.

expeditions.name: Flower Stall Sweet Talk
expeditions.description: The flower stall's owner is at the ward office explaining her awning for the third time, so somebody has to mind the till, take the deliveries, and agree with every last customer. Smile, nod, and let them think it was their idea.

expeditions.name: Make Him Beg
expeditions.description: A client has booked the same three hours for four months and still apologises at the door. Give him the disappointment he paid for, keep him on his knees the whole booking, and let him finish only when told to.

expeditions.name: Peep Show, Six Hours
expeditions.description: Across the rooftops from shrine steps to neon strip — six hours in the rain, notebook, no company. Nothing up there can see her, which is the appeal: the Valley undresses itself after dark, and somebody has to write it down.

expeditions.name: The Hum Job
expeditions.description: The substation fence, midnight until dawn, alone in the rain. The grid hums louder than the load can explain and the crew will not go in alone — they care only that she keeps her hands to herself and does not stop the hum.

expeditions.name: What Opens After Dark
expeditions.description: Walk the Valley from dusk through midday and take every door that opens after dark — the bath-houses that never close, the back rooms that unlock once the neon is on. One instruction: be kind to whoever is still up at four.

expeditions.name: Going Down
expeditions.description: Down under the Valley is an older Valley, flooded to the knee and lit by signs nobody pays for. Eighteen hours, no daylight, no company but whatever has lived down there since the water came. Something will ask her to stay.
